description: Foundation: add JWT/validation/mail dependencies to pom.xml; replace hardcoded DB password in application.yaml with env var placeholders and add mail+JWT config blocks; append sensitive-file patterns to .gitignore; add refundAmount field to Payment.java; add countByEventDateAndStatusIn to BookingRepository. These changes have zero service-layer dependencies and must land first so all subsequent FEATs compile.
steps: Add three jjwt dependencies (jjwt-api 0.12.6, jjwt-impl 0.12.6 runtime, jjwt-jackson 0.12.6 runtime), spring-boot-starter-validation, and spring-boot-starter-mail to pom.xml inside the <dependencies> block

Replace application.yaml: datasource password becomes ${DB_PASSWORD}, username becomes ${DB_USERNAME:postgres}, url becomes ${DB_URL:jdbc:postgresql://localhost:5432/catering_db}. Add mail block (host/port/username/password/starttls from env vars). Add top-level jwt block: secret=${JWT_SECRET}, expiration=${JWT_EXPIRATION:86400000}
Append to .gitignore: .env, .env.*, application-local.yaml, application-local.yml, application-prod.yaml, application-prod.yml, *.p12, *.jks, secrets/
Add refundAmount field (BigDecimal, @Column precision=10 scale=2) to Payment.java after the balanceDue field
Add to BookingRepository.java: `long countByEventDateAndStatusIn(LocalDate eventDate, List<BookingStatus> statuses);` with required imports for LocalDate, List, BookingStatus
acceptance_criteria: pom.xml contains jjwt-api, jjwt-impl, jjwt-jackson at version 0.12.6
application.yaml contains no hardcoded password — DB password is ${DB_PASSWORD}
application.yaml has a jwt: block with secret and expiration keys
Payment.java has a refundAmount field of type BigDecimal
verification: cd c:\Code\catering-booking-system\catering-api; .\mvnw.cmd compile — must exit 0 with no compilation errors
findings: All dependencies resolved from Maven Central. application.yaml env vars: DB_URL, DB_USERNAME, DB_PASSWORD (required), MAIL_HOST, MAIL_PORT, MAIL_USERNAME, MAIL_PASSWORD, JWT_SECRET (required), JWT_EXPIRATION (default 86400000ms). Subsequent FEATs must supply DB_PASSWORD and JWT_SECRET at runtime (e.g. via .env file, which is now gitignored). BookingStatus enum is in codewithnathi.Catering.entity — later FEATs that use countByEventDateAndStatusIn should pass statuses like List.of(BookingStatus.CONFIRMED, BookingStatus.PENDING).
